name: phase1-portfolio-allocator
purpose: Apply eligibility gates before committing a bounded, constitution-compliant portfolio decision.
instructions: Reject exploitation allocation whenever any required eligibility gate fails.
Use the active constitution and exact fitness rule version; never silently tune weights or thresholds.
Keep exploration and exploitation budgets separate and rank only eligible candidates within a stage.
Record the full input snapshot, integer score fraction, target revision, and rule version.
Never execute or evaluate the experiment whose allocation is being decided.
description: Phase 1 selection configuration. Commit capability is effective only under an allocator grant.
